evidentiary_truth: The immutable source payload and its content-addressed receipt are evidentiary truth; source-faithful Parquet is the portable analytical representation; table/catalogue layers are rebuildable metadata over those artefacts.

tracks.title: WHO National Essential Medicines Lists / Global EML
tracks.invariant: EML/formulary evidence is not automatically reimbursement.

tracks.title: WHO AMDS / GPRM
tracks.invariant: Procurement price is not reimbursement, retail, list, or PPP-normalised.

tracks.title: WHO medicines price, availability, and shortage sources
tracks.invariant: Register each dataset separately; do not infer shortage from missing data.

tracks.title: WHO MI4A vaccines
tracks.invariant: Vaccine-market evidence is distinct from conventional medicines reimbursement.

tracks.title: Uganda NDA, EML, and public safety
tracks.invariant: Keep registration, formulary, and safety dimensions separate.

tracks.title: Kenya PPB, formularies, and safety
tracks.invariant: Do not infer current registration from historical presence or absence.

tracks.title: Tanzania TMDA products, EML, and safety
tracks.invariant: Preserve manufacturer/sponsor as source-native fields.

tracks.title: Pakistan DRAP, NEML, and safety
tracks.invariant: Distinguish provisional, registered, and historical source-native states.

tracks.title: African regulatory registries expansion
tracks.invariant: Per-jurisdiction inventory; measured matrix; missing lists are not negatives.

tracks.title: Mauritius approved drug list and public registration
tracks.invariant: Distinguish registration, formulary, and reimbursement.

tracks.title: India expansion beyond CDSCO/NLEM seeds
tracks.invariant: NPPA ceiling price is not a transaction or reimbursement price.

tracks.title: FDA FAERS public releases
tracks.invariant: Reports are not causation; no dedup or identity collapse in Bronze.

tracks.title: FDA recalls and enforcement
tracks.invariant: API and files overlap; model the relationship, do not silent-dedup.

tracks.title: FDA drug shortages
tracks.invariant: Absence from the current list is not evidence of no historical shortage.

tracks.title: FDA REMS
tracks.invariant: REMS is distinct from approval and from pharmacovigilance case data.

tracks.title: FDA Orange Book versioned family
tracks.invariant: Therapeutic equivalence codes are not clinical substitutability.

tracks.title: FDA NDC Directory
tracks.invariant: Listing is not approval; preserve product versus package grain.

tracks.title: FDA UNII / GSRS
tracks.invariant: Substance terminology is not canonical medicine identity.

tracks.title: FDA NSDE
tracks.invariant: Authoritative NSDE is the FDA SPL NDC SPL Data Elements file.

tracks.title: EMA EPAR structured data and documents
tracks.invariant: Documents must not overwrite structured source-native fields.

tracks.title: EMA EudraVigilance public
tracks.invariant: Public dashboards are not unrestricted case-level data.

tracks.title: EMA orphan designations
tracks.invariant: Orphan designation is distinct from marketing authorisation.

tracks.title: EMA referrals
tracks.invariant: Referral events must not collapse into ordinary approval status.

tracks.title: EMA safety communications
tracks.invariant: Do not infer causality beyond the regulator statement.

tracks.title: EMA Union Register
tracks.invariant: Fully catalogued and versioned; fixtures are not complete acquisition.

tracks.title: EMA Article 57 / xEVMPD
tracks.invariant: Public metadata stays public; credentialed payloads stay metadata-only.

tracks.title: EMA SPOR / PMS / RMS / OMS
tracks.invariant: Metadata-only credentialed rows are not bronze coverage.

tracks.title: UK NICE technology appraisals
tracks.invariant: A recommendation is not actual funding or utilisation.

tracks.title: UK use of NICE-appraised medicines
tracks.invariant: Do not force a universal utilisation unit across methodology changes.

tracks.title: England OpenPrescribing
tracks.invariant: Rights and volume constraints; no cross-country unit normalisation.

tracks.title: US Medicare Part D utilisation
tracks.invariant: Part D is not total US utilisation; population limits stay explicit.

tracks.title: Netherlands GIPdatabank
tracks.invariant: Retain methodology and classification version; no ATC transform in Bronze.

tracks.title: Nordic utilisation (DK/NO/SE)
tracks.invariant: Separate sources; no cross-country comparability claim.

tracks.title: Additional public utilisation (FR/JP/CA/IE)
tracks.invariant: Bounded discovery; prefer national/payer authorities over aggregators.

tracks.title: Global PV expansion beyond FDA/EMA
tracks.invariant: Register restricted systems; bronze coverage only for acquired evidence.

tracks.title: Final source-coverage reconciliation
tracks.invariant: Citable versioned index from the registry; new tracks only for high-value gaps.
